title: Google Trends Probe
description: Measures how Google Trends answers from where this run exits: every request becomes one dataset row (endpoint, status, latency, bytes, exit IP) and the OUTPUT record sums it up. Leave everything empty to run the default battery: curl_cffi as Chrome, no proxy, 30 keywords, 1.5 s between Google requests.

client.title: HTTP client
client.description: curl_cffi sends Chrome's TLS and HTTP/2 fingerprint. httpx sends Python's TLS fingerprint over HTTP/1.1 with a Chrome User-Agent, like a plain scraper.

impersonate.title: curl_cffi browser
impersonate.description: curl_cffi impersonation target, such as chrome (the newest Chrome curl_cffi knows) or chrome146. Ignored by httpx.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: No proxy by default, so traffic exits from the Apify server itself. Pick a datacenter or residential group to compare; a group the account cannot use ends the run with the refusal in OUTPUT.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One explore flow per keyword, in order. Empty uses 30 varied real searches.

geo.title: Country
geo.description: Two-letter country code for explore, such as US. Empty means worldwide. The trending RSS uses US when this is empty.

timeframe.title: Time range
timeframe.description: Google Trends time parameter, such as today 12-m (53 weekly points), today 3-m, now 7-d or 2024-01-01 2024-12-31.

includeRelated.title: Also fetch related queries and region breakdown
includeRelated.description: Adds widgetdata/relatedsearches and widgetdata/comparedgeo after each successful multiline, two more Google requests per keyword.

warmup.title: Cookie warmup per session
warmup.description: What each session fetches first for the NID cookie. home: https://trends.google.com/trends/, as a browser does (about 690 KB). rss: the trending RSS, which also sets NID (about 21 KB, 33x less residential traffic). none: no warmup, to test whether explore needs the cookie at all.

delayMs.title: Gap between Google requests (ms)
delayMs.description: Time from the end of one Google request to the start of the next. Requests are never sent in parallel.

newSessionEvery.title: New session every N keywords
newSessionEvery.description: Fresh cookie jar, new warmup and, behind a proxy, a new proxy session (new exit IP) every N keywords. 0 keeps one session for the whole run.

retry429.title: Retries after a 429
retry429.description: How many times to retry a keyword's explore and multiline flow after HTTP 429 or a redirect to google.com/sorry. 0 records the 429 and moves on.

retryBackoffSecs.title: First backoff after a 429 (s)
retryBackoffSecs.description: Wait before the first retry; it doubles for each further retry, capped at 120 s.

rotateOn429.title: New session before each retry
rotateOn429.description: On: a 429 retry starts a new session (new cookies and, behind a proxy, a new exit IP). Off: it retries on the same session.

maxGoogleRequests.title: Max Google requests
maxGoogleRequests.description: Hard cap on requests to Google in one run, retries and warmups included. IP lookups do not count.
